OddsType.OddsDescription:
Standard 1X2: Predict the final outcome of the match in regular time. The bet offers three possible outcomes: 1 (home team wins); X (teams draw), 2 (away team wins)
 Fantasy 1X2: Predict which team/player will score most goals in their respective matches. If both teams/players score the same number of goals, the winning selection will be X. Both players must start the match. If either or both players do not start Goalscorer bets will be void. Extra-Time and Penalty shoot-out goals do not count.

Predict the outcome of the first half of the match. There are 3 possible outcomes: 1X (home team wins or draws at 1st half), X2 (away team wins or draws at 1st half), 12 (home team wins or the away team wins at 1st half).

Predict the outcome of the 2nd half time of the match. There are 3 possible outcomes: 1X (home team wins or draws at 2nd half), X2 (away team wins or draws at 2nd half), 12 (home team wins or the away team wins at 2nd half).
Predict which team will win 1st half of a match. Bets placed on this market will be void if 1st half ends in a draw.
Predict which team will win 2nd half of a match. Bets placed on this market will be void if 2nd half ends in a draw.

Predict if the two teams will score at least one goal each during 1st half of the match. The bet offers two possible outcomes: GG (both teams will score at least one goal during the 1st half); NG (one or none of the two teams will score at least one goal during the 1st half).

Predict if the two teams will score at least one goal each during 2nd half time of the match. The bet offers two possible outcomes: GG (both teams will score at least one goal during the 2nd half); NG (one or none of the two teams will score at least one goal during the 2nd half).
Predict whether the number of goals scored in first half of a match will be under/over the value specified.
Predict whether the number of goals scored in second half of a match will be under/over the value specified.
Predict whether the number of goals scored in first half of a match will be under/over the value specified.
Predict whether the number of goals scored in second half of a match will be under/over the value specified.
Predict whether the number of goals scored in first half of a match will be under/over the value specified.
Predict whether the number of goals scored in second half of a match will be under/over the value specified.
Predict the actual scoreline of the 1st half.
Predict the actual scoreline of the 2nd half.

Predict the first half outcome of a match after the indicated handicap score has been applied to the half time result . For example, handicap score (0:2) indicates that the away team was given two goals advantage, handicap score (0.5:0) indicates that home team was given 0.5 goals advantage, etc. Asian handicap is two-way handicap, meaning that there are only 2 possible outcomes - win of the home team (1H) or win of the away team (2H). In the case of a whole goal handicap (value in brackets ends with ''1" or "4''), if the result is level after the handicap is taken into consideration, then all bets are void and stake refunded. By placing bet on value in brackets that represents quarter of one or more goals (value in brackets ends with ''0.5'' or ''1.5''), the bet can be half won (half of the stake multiplied by the odds is won) or half lost (half of the stake will be refunded).

Predict the 2nd half time outcome of a match after the indicated handicap score has been applied to the result . For example, handicap score (0:2) indicates that the away team was given two goals advantage, handicap score (0.5:0) indicates that home team was given 0.5 goals advantage, etc. Asian handicap is two-way handicap, meaning that there are only 2 possible outcomes - win of the home team (1H) or win of the away team (2H). In the case of a whole goal handicap (value in brackets ends with ''1" or "4''), if the result is level after the handicap is taken into consideration, then all bets are void and stake refunded. By placing bet on value in brackets that represents quarter of one or more goals (value in brackets ends with ''0.5'' or ''1.5''), the bet can be half won (half of the stake multiplied by the odds is won) or half lost (half of the stake will be refunded).
